text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Agnes Digital busily
working in
front of a supermarket.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hi, come on in! Carrots are on sale for
cheap
today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! You're a trainer from Tracen,
right? Why
don't you take this
opportunity to buy some
carrots for your
trainee?

text_block_list.name: Supermarket Owner
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Digital! Thanks for your
help today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I'd better head to my next
destination
ASAP! Time to put these
legs I've strengthened
through racing
and simping to use!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following this, I start spotting Agnes
Digital
practically everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Our bakery's open for business again
after
renovations! Come check out our
Uma-shaped
carrot bread!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Heya! Here's your House of Speed carrot
ramen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The newest line of face powders has just
come in!
We have all kinds of cosmetics
made for
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not that they need any makeup since
their skin's
always so flawless!
Teehuehue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's working from morning
till night.
I'm curious as to why, so I
decide to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I've been running into you a lot...
Are you
trying to trigger some sort of
event?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hehe, glad you asked!
choice_data_list: なんでそんなにバイトを？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One of my fave's long-awaited photo
book will be
releasing soon, and she's
holding a signing event!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Autograph sessions like these are big
moments
for my oshis, and as a fan, I
can't attend them
wearing just any old
outfit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I always make it a point to wear
something nice
that'll match the person
I'm meeting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's doing what's proper! Meeting
your oshi is a
special occasion! When
else would I dress up?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She's an angel... No, a veritable goddess!
choice_data_list: 推しってどんなウマ娘？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you want to know the date and
location of
the book signing, here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital hands me a flyer detailing
the
information of the event.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I bet you're wondering why I just happen
to be
carrying that around, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's because a true fan should always be
equipped
to spread the good word!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's because a true fan should always be
equipped
to spread the good word!
choice_data_list: 憧れは自分の力になるもんな
憧れは自分の力になるもんね

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Best of luck to us both at the event!
Oh... I'm so
excited, there's no way I'm
getting any sleep!
choice_data_list: 憧れは自分の力になるもんな
憧れは自分の力になるもんね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm so impressed by Agnes Digital's
fervor that I
end up going to her favorite
Umamusume's book
signing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the vast number of fans there,
the
Umamusume in question gives each
of them great
individual attention.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you went to the signing event too? I
knew
you had potential in you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There was a celebratory flower display
put
together by all the fans who've been
supporting
her since day one... It was so
touching!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What's more, I was able to make a new
simp
friend! I couldn't have asked for a
more bountiful
harvest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Teehuehue! No need to be so modest
about it!
You're already a model simp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I see Agnes Digital while
walking
through the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How was the signing event? Was she not
the most
precious thing in the entire
WORLD?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Teehuehue... I bet you want to dress a
little nicer
next time you meet your oshi
now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of which, I need to start
putting
together my next outfit too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, see you at the next event! Let's
cheer on
our oshis with all our heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! If it's for the sake of my oshis,
I'll work
day and night and overcome
any obstacle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mwaheehee... If that isn't the best thing
ever, I
don't know what is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course, your trainee is also a divine
idol who
gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying, but I'm a huge
simp for
every single Uma at Tracen!
Huehue! ♪
